# Voyager -- Complete Reference

> Voyager is an open-source (GPLv3) browser extension that adds timeline navigation, folder organization, prompt vault, chat export, and 20+ productivity features to Google Gemini and Google AI Studio, and extends Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek through its plugin engine. Works on Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Opera, and Brave.

## Project Overview

Voyager is designed as a comprehensive workspace layer for AI chat. It addresses the gap between what chat assistants do well and the organizational tools users need to manage long conversations, save prompts, export data, and navigate complex chat histories. Gemini and AI Studio get the full first-party feature set; Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek are supported as plugin platforms through the Voyager Plugin Engine; and the Prompt Manager can be pointed at any site you add, local apps included.

The extension is built with TypeScript and React, uses Manifest V3 for cross-browser compatibility, and stores all data locally in the browser using `chrome.storage`. Optional Google Drive sync is available for cross-device backup. Voyager collects no user data, has no analytics, and no third-party servers.

- **Version**: 1.9.0
- **License**: GPLv3
- **Author**: Jesse Zhang
- **Repository**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager
- **Documentation**: https://voyager.nagi.fun
- **Languages**: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic

## Installation

### Extension Stores (Recommended)

- **Chrome / Brave / Opera / Vivaldi**: Install from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/voyager/iifacdnjakkhjjiengaffnegbndgingi)
- **Microsoft Edge**: Install from [Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/voyager/gibmkggjijalcjinbdhcpklodjkhhlne) or the Chrome Web Store
- **Firefox**: Install from [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/gemini-voyager/)
- **Safari (macOS)**: Download the pre-signed `.dmg` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/releases)

Edge users can keep using the Edge Add-ons build, which remains maintained for mobile and tablet needs. If Edge review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

### Manual Installation (Latest Features)

1. Download the latest release from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/releases).
2. For Chrome/Edge: Unzip, open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer Mode, click "Load unpacked."
3. For Firefox: Drag and drop the `.xpi` file into the Add-ons Manager.
4. For Safari: Open the `.dmg`, install the app, enable the extension in Safari Settings > Extensions.

## Supported Platforms

| Platform | Support Level |
|----------|--------------|
| Google Gemini (gemini.google.com) | Full -- all features |
| Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) | Partial -- folders, prompts, sidebar width, formula copy, send behavior |
| Gemini for Enterprise (business.gemini.google) | Prompt Manager only |
| Claude (claude.ai) | Plugin platform -- timeline, formula copy, Vim input, reading width, everyday helpers, CJK render fix |
| ChatGPT (chatgpt.com, chat.openai.com) | Plugin platform -- timeline, folders, export, formula copy, Vim input, reading width, everyday helpers |
| DeepSeek (chat.deepseek.com) | Plugin platform -- optional timeline, formula copy, Vim input, reading width, everyday helpers, code wrapping |
| Any site added in the popup (localhost included) | Prompt Manager |

## Core Features

### Timeline Navigation

Voyager Timeline is a visual conversation navigation system for Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. It maps every message in a chat to an interactive node on the right side of the screen, turning long AI conversations into a navigable map.

**Capabilities**:
- Click any node to jump instantly to that message
- Hover a node to preview its content without scrolling
- Long-press a node to star (bookmark) it for later reference
- Right-click a node to set levels (1-3) or collapse children
- Drag the inner edge to resize the timeline width
- Choose a Nodes, Ruler, or Compact timeline style
- Pin the preview panel beside the timeline; its search box filters messages as you type
- Drag the timeline anywhere on the page, and reset its position from the popup
- Vim-style keyboard shortcuts: `j`/`k` to navigate, `gg`/`GG` to jump to first/last turn
- All keyboard shortcuts are fully customizable
- Starred messages sync across devices via Cloud Sync and collect in the Saved Library

**When to use**: Conversations longer than 10 messages, research sessions, code debugging, brainstorming reviews, team handoffs.

**Availability**: Gemini, plus Claude and ChatGPT as built-in plugins; DeepSeek has an optional timeline plugin. Not available on AI Studio. All browsers.

### Folder Organization

A drag-and-drop folder system for organizing Gemini conversations with nested hierarchy, custom colors, and AI-powered auto-organization.

**Capabilities**:
- Drag and drop conversations into folders
- Create nested folders (folders inside folders)
- Customize folder colors (7 defaults + custom color picker)
- Multi-select: long-press to enter multi-select mode, move multiple conversations at once
- Hide filed conversations from the sidebar (inbox-zero for AI chats); on AI Studio they are hidden from the Library table
- Activity view: click the bell beside Folders to list folder conversations by real chat activity, with the last three hours under Priority
- Account isolation: show chats from the current Google account only, or turn on Hard Isolation to keep folder and cloud-sync data separate per account
- AI Auto-Organize: one-click copies your conversation structure, paste into Gemini to generate a folder plan, then import the JSON result
- Folder as Project: set folder-level instructions that prepend to the first message in new chats, and file those chats automatically (inspired by Claude Projects)
- Adjustable folder spacing (compact to spacious)
- Search conversations within folders

**AI Studio specific**: Sidebar width adjustment, Library integration (drag from Library into folders).

**ChatGPT**: Folders also come to ChatGPT as a built-in plugin, with a folder section in ChatGPT's sidebar.

**Availability**: Gemini and AI Studio; ChatGPT through the plugin engine. All browsers.

### Prompt Vault (Prompt Library)

A personal repository for saving, organizing, and reusing prompts across any AI platform.

**Capabilities**:
- Save any prompt from the floating Prompt Manager ball, which sits next to the input area and can be dragged anywhere
- Organize prompts with tags (#coding, #email, #research)
- Search by keyword or tag
- One-click insertion into the conversation input
- Optional name labels for quick identification
- Compact list view (10+ prompts visible) and comfortable card view
- Fast hover preview (250ms) in compact mode
- Folder organization for prompts
- Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek: turn on the site's switch in the popup and grant access
- Any other site you add in the popup, localhost included (for example DeepSeek Harness on `localhost:3080`); only the Prompt Manager loads there

**Availability**: Gemini and AI Studio, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and any site you add. All browsers.

### Chat Export

Export any Gemini or ChatGPT conversation to Markdown, PDF, JSON, or an image.

**Format comparison**:
- **Markdown**: Best for note apps (Obsidian, Notion). Smallest file size. Preserves code blocks with syntax. Images embedded.
- **PDF**: Best for sharing and printing. Largest file size. All images included. Beautifully formatted.
- **JSON**: Best for developers and data analysis. Raw data preserved. Programmatic access to conversation structure.
- **Image**: Best for sharing on mobile. Rendered as it appears on the page.

**How to export**: Click the **Export** button at the top right of the page, then choose a format. On Gemini you can also choose **Export conversation history** from a conversation's or response's menu.

**Deep Research export**: Voyager extracts the full research process including thinking steps, source links, and the final report from Gemini Deep Research sessions.

**Safari support**: Markdown and JSON image extraction are supported. PDF export uses a manual Command+P step after clicking export.

**Availability**: Gemini, plus ChatGPT as a built-in plugin. All browsers.

### Cloud Sync

Back up folders, prompt library, starred messages, and supported settings to Google Drive, or to iCloud on Safari.

**What syncs**: Folder structure (nesting, colors, assignments), prompt library (prompts, tags, folders), starred prompts, forks, timeline hierarchy, cross-device settings, and plugin configuration (site permissions stay per device). Model answers, device identifiers, tokens, and caches are not synced.

**How it works**:
1. Choose a provider. Google Drive asks for the `drive.file` permission (most restrictive scope -- Voyager can only access files it created). iCloud on Safari uses the Mac's signed-in iCloud account and a private CloudKit database.
2. Click "Upload" to sync local data to the cloud.
3. Click "Download & Merge" on another device to intelligently merge cloud data with local data.
4. Sync is manual and on-demand -- no background sync.

**Privacy**: Data flows directly between your browser and your own Google Drive or iCloud. No Voyager sync server. `drive.file` scope means Voyager cannot read any other file in your Drive.

**Availability**: Google Drive on Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari. iCloud only in the directly distributed Safari app.

### Formula Copy

Click a rendered formula to copy it. Choose the format ahead of time in the popup: LaTeX, LaTeX without dollar signs, MathML for Microsoft Word, or Notion's `$$` format.

**Availability**: Gemini and AI Studio, plus Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek via the plugin engine. All browsers.

## Gemini Exclusive Features

These features work only on Google Gemini (gemini.google.com), not on AI Studio.

### Quote Reply

Select any text in a conversation to quote it and reply with context. The selected text is automatically inserted as a quotation in your next message.

### Batch Delete

Select multiple conversations from the sidebar and delete them all at once. Enter multi-select mode, check the conversations you want to remove, and confirm.

### Deep Research Export

Extract research processes, thinking steps, and source links from Gemini Deep Research sessions.

### Mermaid Diagram Rendering

Render Mermaid diagram code blocks inline in conversations. Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, and other Mermaid diagram types.

### Markdown Rendering Fix

Gemini sometimes inserts HTML elements such as citations inside text, which breaks Markdown bold syntax (`**text**`). Voyager repairs these broken bold tags automatically.

### Image Refinement (Watermark Removal)

Lossless watermark removal from Gemini-generated images, preserving full image quality.

### Sidebar Auto-hide

The sidebar automatically collapses when your mouse leaves it and expands when you move back. Turn on **Fully hide sidebar** to hide the collapsed rail as well.

### Prevent Auto Scroll

When you have scrolled up to read history, sending a new prompt no longer forces the page down to the new response. Off by default.

### Input Collapse

When the input area is empty and loses focus, it collapses into a compact pill; click it or press Ctrl/⌘+I to expand. Off by default.

### Recent Gems in Sidebar

Expand Gemini's native Gems entry into a list of your gems: pinned gems first, then the ones you used most recently. Set the count from 1 to 10, or 0 to hide it.

### Usage Status Bar

Show Gemini's daily and weekly usage limits in a small draggable bar inside the chat. It refreshes quietly after responses, stores its numbers locally, and is off by default.

### Default Model

Star a model in Gemini's model menu and every new chat starts with it. Starring the Extended thinking option carries that over too.

### Conversation Fork (Experimental)

Branch a conversation from any of your prompts. Voyager carries the context up to that point into a new chat, either filled into the input or as a downloaded Markdown file, and records the branch without changing the original.

### Context Sync to IDE (Experimental)

Send conversation context to VS Code or a compatible editor through the CoBridge extension, so your IDE agent picks up where the web discussion left off.

### User Message LaTeX Rendering

Render LaTeX formulas in your own messages, not just in Gemini's responses.

### Message Timestamps

Auto-record when each message was sent. Trace your conversation timeline with precise timestamps.

### Send Behavior

Choose between Enter-to-send (default Gemini behavior) or Ctrl/⌘+Enter-to-send (Enter creates a newline). AI Studio has the reverse option, and Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek get it as a plugin.

### Font Size Control

Adjust the chat font size between 80% and 150% for comfortable reading, without affecting the rest of the Gemini interface.

### Visual Effects

Switch between snow, rain, and sakura petal visual effects from the extension popup. Decorative overlays for your chat interface.

## Plugin Platform Features

Beyond the first-party Gemini and AI Studio integration, Voyager extends other chat sites through the Voyager Plugin Engine -- declarative JSON plugins that describe selectors and behavior per site. See https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/plugins.

### Timeline

The same timeline as on Gemini, with starred messages and search.

**Availability**: Claude and ChatGPT (built in); DeepSeek (optional plugin, ships disabled).

### ChatGPT Folders and Export

Organize ChatGPT conversations into folders (on by default), and export a conversation as Markdown, JSON, PDF, or an image.

**Availability**: ChatGPT.

### Formula Copy

Click a formula to copy its LaTeX.

**Availability**: Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek.

### Comfortable Reading Width

Widen the conversation into one centered, adjustable reading column.

**Availability**: Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek.

### CJK Render Fix

Fixes rendering issues with Chinese, Japanese, and Korean characters.

**Availability**: Claude.

### Vim Input

Vim-style modal editing and cursor navigation in the prompt composer.

**Availability**: Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek.

### Everyday Helpers

Quote replies, Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send, and a draft counter; draft auto-save on Claude and DeepSeek.

**Availability**: Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek.

### Code Wrapping

Long code lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping, so indentation survives. Wrapping can be turned back on per preference.

**Availability**: DeepSeek.

### Prompt Manager Anywhere

Add any site in the extension popup and the Prompt Manager follows you there, including local apps such as DeepSeek Harness on localhost.

**Availability**: Any user-added site.

## Write your own plugin

Anyone can make a local plugin: a declarative `plugin.json` manifest plus CSS that changes how a supported site looks or is laid out. It runs no code, lives only in the browser, and needs no pull request. Voyager checks it on import, it starts switched off, and turning it off reverts every change.

- **In the chat**: in the popup's My creations card, write one sentence, Copy for this chat, paste it in that AI chat. The AI reads https://voyager.nagi.fun/create/<site>.md and replies with JSON to paste back.
- **Coding agent**: Copy for a local agent points it at https://voyager.nagi.fun/skills/write-voyager-plugin/SKILL.md. It writes `plugin.json` and `style.css` to import.
- **By hand**: `npx create-voyager-plugin@latest init my-plugin --site <gemini|aistudio|chatgpt|claude|deepseek>`, then `npx create-voyager-plugin@latest check my-plugin`, which runs the popup's import checks offline and exits 0 when the plugin would import.

A plugin can add scoped `gv-` classes and CSS, set safe attributes and inline styles, hide elements, and offer boolean, number or select settings that reach CSS through `{{key}}` tokens. On ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek it can also enable Voyager primitives and tint Voyager's UI. It cannot run JavaScript, react to events, load network resources, read or rewrite message text, or run on unsupported sites.

Guide: https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/write-a-plugin. Manifest schema: https://voyager.nagi.fun/plugin.schema.json.

## Privacy and Security

Voyager is designed with privacy as a core principle:

- **No data collection**: Voyager does not collect, transmit, or store any user data on external servers.
- **Local storage only**: All extension data (folders, prompts, settings) is stored in `chrome.storage.local` within your browser.
- **Optional cloud sync**: Google Drive sync uses OAuth2 with `drive.file` scope (can only access files Voyager created); iCloud sync on Safari uses your private CloudKit database. Data goes directly to your own account -- no intermediary servers.
- **Plugin catalog updates**: on a site where you have enabled a plugin, Voyager may fetch that site's catalog file from voyager.nagi.fun: a plain GET with no cookies, identifiers, or page content, which you can switch off in the popup. Gemini and AI Studio never trigger it.
- **No tracking**: No analytics, no telemetry, no usage tracking of any kind.
- **Minimal permissions**: Host access is granted at install only for Gemini, Gemini Enterprise, AI Studio, and the Google domains needed for Drive and image operations. Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and custom sites are reached only after you enable them and approve the browser prompt; notifications are requested only if you turn on response-completion notifications.
- **Open source**: Full source code is available on GitHub under GPLv3 for audit.
- **Privacy policy**: https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/privacy

## Browser Compatibility

| Browser | Status | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| Chrome | Full support | Primary development target |
| Microsoft Edge | Full support | Install via Edge Add-ons or Chrome Web Store |
| Firefox | Full support | Signed XPI for permanent installation |
| Safari (macOS) | Full support | Native Google Drive/iCloud sync, notifications, and Sparkle updates |
| Opera | Full support | Install via Chrome Web Store |
| Brave | Full support | Install via Chrome Web Store |
| Vivaldi | Full support | Install via Chrome Web Store |

## Technical Details

- **Runtime**: Manifest V3 browser extension
- **Language**: TypeScript + React
- **Build tool**: Vite with Bun package manager
- **Testing**: Vitest with jsdom
- **Storage**: chrome.storage.local (primary), chrome.storage.sync (settings), chrome.storage.session (temporary)
- **Cloud sync**: Google Drive API with OAuth2 (drive.file scope); CloudKit for iCloud on Safari
- **Supported sites**: gemini.google.com, business.gemini.google, aistudio.google.com, aistudio.google.cn (first-party); claude.ai, chatgpt.com, chat.openai.com, chat.deepseek.com (plugin platforms); any user-added site for the Prompt Manager
- **Plugin engine**: declarative JSON plugins per site, see https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/plugins
